Meera (prod): Quick post-all-hands note: customers asked for one-line proof points for SOC2/ISO about logs and keys. Can security/compliance give bite-sized answers we can use in sales collateral?

Jordan (security): Sure. Short bullets: - Logs: daily signed export bundles (manifest + events + signature). - Keys: BYOK = cloud KMS; BYOQ = customer HSM attestation included.

Tara (compliance): Add this sentence for auditors: "Redwood provides verifiable export bundles with SHA256 checksums and a digital signature; customers can archive these bundles in their own storage for audit retention requirements."

Ben (infra): Tech caveat to include: default hosted retention = 90 days; daily export to a customer bucket is supported for arbitrarily long retention. Full payload capture is opt-in and truncated by default to avoid accidental PII retention.

Meera (prod): Perfect. Can someone paste the example export filename pattern and a one-line BYOQ vs BYOK line?

Jordan (security): Filename example: exports/2026-09-01/<tenant>/audit-bundle-20260901.tar.gz. BYOK vs BYOQ line: BYOK = you manage keys in a cloud KMS we integrate with; BYOQ = you keep key material in your HSM and we include attestation evidence.

OfficeHours Bot: Reminder: Security office hours "Audit exports & KMS clarifications" at 2001238200. RSVP: https://calendar.redwood.company/officehours-security

Tara (compliance): Actions: I'll draft the auditor checklist and Meera can pull the one-liners into sales enablement. Jordan/Ben to add snippets to docs.

Meera (prod): Thanks team ":thumbsup:"
